text: 独在异乡为异客，每逢佳节倍思亲
pinyin: dú zài yì xiāng wéi yì kè, měi féng jiā jié bèi sī qīn
literal: alone · in · foreign · land · be · foreign · guest, every · meet · good · festival · doubly · miss · kin
natural: Alone in a foreign land, a stranger among strangers, I miss my family twice as much at every festival

meaning.en: Homesickness peaks on holidays; quoted by people away from home at festivals.
meaning.zh: 独自在外地做客，每到节日加倍思念亲人。

equivalents: missing family twice as much at festivals

examples.zh: 春节没能回家，他想起“独在异乡为异客，每逢佳节倍思亲”。
examples.en: Unable to go home for Spring Festival, he thought of '§'.

examples.zh: “独在异乡为异客，每逢佳节倍思亲”，中秋夜我格外想家。
examples.en: '§': on Mid-Autumn night I missed home all the more.

origin.source: 王维《九月九日忆山东兄弟》

story.en: Wang Wei wrote it at seventeen, far from his home east of the mountains, on the Double Ninth Festival.
story.zh: 王维少年时客居长安，重阳节思念山东的兄弟而作。

usage.en: A quoted line of verse; literary, common in essays, captions and speeches.
usage.zh: 引用的诗句，书面语，常见于作文、文案和演讲。

text: 遥知兄弟登高处，遍插茱萸少一人
pinyin: yáo zhī xiōng dì dēng gāo chù, biàn chā zhū yú shǎo yī rén
literal: far · know · brothers · climb · height · place, everywhere · stick · dogwood · lacking · one · person
natural: I know my brothers are climbing the heights, all wearing dogwood, one person short

meaning.en: Picturing the family gathered at a festival with you missing; quoted for the pang of absence.
meaning.zh: 遥想兄弟们登高，每人插着茱萸，唯独少了我一人，写节日里对亲人的思念。

equivalents: one short at the family gathering

examples.zh: 全家团聚的合照里，他不在，真是“遥知兄弟登高处，遍插茱萸少一人”。
examples.en: He was missing from the family reunion photo: truly '§'.

examples.zh: 重阳节，他吟起“遥知兄弟登高处，遍插茱萸少一人”。
examples.en: On the Double Ninth he recited '§'.

origin.source: 王维《九月九日忆山东兄弟》

story.en: The closing couplet of Wang Wei's poem: he imagines his brothers' Double Ninth outing without him.
story.zh: 此诗末二句，想象兄弟重阳登高时缺了自己。

usage.en: A quoted line of verse; literary, common in essays, captions and speeches.
usage.zh: 引用的诗句，书面语，常见于作文、文案和演讲。

text: 劝君更尽一杯酒，西出阳关无故人
pinyin: quàn jūn gèng jìn yī bēi jiǔ, xī chū yáng guān wú gù rén
literal: urge · you · further · drain · one · cup · wine, west · exit · Yangguan · no · old · friends
natural: I urge you to drain one more cup; west of Yang Pass you will have no old friends

meaning.en: A farewell toast to a friend heading to a distant frontier; quoted at partings.
meaning.zh: 劝朋友再饮一杯，出了阳关就没有老朋友了，是送别时的名句。

equivalents: one more drink before you go

examples.zh: 送他去外地工作时，我举杯说“劝君更尽一杯酒，西出阳关无故人”。
examples.en: Seeing him off to work elsewhere, I raised my glass and said '§'.

examples.zh: 饯行宴上，大家一起念起“劝君更尽一杯酒，西出阳关无故人”。
examples.en: At the farewell dinner everyone recited '§'.

story.en: Wang Wei sent his friend Yuan Er off on a diplomatic mission to Anxi in the far west.
story.zh: 王维送友人元二出使安西，在渭城饯别。

usage.en: A farewell toast; literary, often said when parting.
usage.zh: 送别祝酒语，书面语。

text: 空山不见人，但闻人语响
pinyin: kōng shān bù jiàn rén, dàn wén rén yǔ xiǎng
literal: empty · mountain · not · see · people, only · hear · people · voices · echo
natural: In the empty mountain no one is seen, only the echo of voices is heard

meaning.en: The silence of mountains broken only by distant voices; quoted for quiet, secluded scenery.
meaning.zh: 空旷的山中看不见人，只听见人语的回声，写出山中的幽静。

equivalents: a silent mountain with distant voices

examples.zh: 山谷里寂静无人，只觉“空山不见人，但闻人语响”。
examples.en: The valley was silent and empty, just '§'.

examples.zh: 这首“空山不见人，但闻人语响”以动衬静。
examples.en: The poem '§' uses sound to set off silence.

story.en: Wang Wei's quatrain on his Wang River retreat; the sound of voices only deepens the stillness.
story.zh: 王维辋川诗之一，以人语声反衬空山的寂静。

usage.en: A quoted line of verse; literary, common in essays, captions and speeches.
usage.zh: 引用的诗句，书面语，常见于作文、文案和演讲。

text: 大漠孤烟直，长河落日圆
pinyin: dà mò gū yān zhí, cháng hé luò rì yuán
literal: great · desert · lone · smoke · straight, long · river · setting · sun · round
natural: In the vast desert a lone column of smoke rises straight; over the long river the setting sun is round

meaning.en: A grand, austere frontier scene; quoted for sweeping desert vistas.
meaning.zh: 大漠上一缕孤烟笔直，长河上落日浑圆，描绘壮阔苍茫的边塞景象。

equivalents: desert smoke and a round sunset

examples.zh: 在敦煌看日落，才懂什么叫“大漠孤烟直，长河落日圆”。
examples.en: Watching sunset in Dunhuang, I understood '§'.

examples.zh: 摄影展的主题就是“大漠孤烟直，长河落日圆”。
examples.en: The photography exhibition's theme was '§'.

story.en: Wang Wei travelled to the northwest frontier on official business in 737 and described the desert scene.
story.zh: 王维奉命出使塞上，途中所作。

usage.en: A quoted line of verse; literary, common in essays, captions and speeches.
usage.zh: 引用的诗句，书面语，常见于作文、文案和演讲。

text: 行到水穷处，坐看云起时
pinyin: xíng dào shuǐ qióng chù, zuò kàn yún qǐ shí
literal: walk · to · water · end · place, sit · watch · clouds · rise · time
natural: I walk to where the stream ends, then sit and watch the clouds rise

meaning.en: When you reach a dead end, calmly find new beauty; quoted for a serene attitude in hard times.
meaning.zh: 走到溪水尽头，就坐下看云起，比喻身处困境仍能泰然处之，另有新境。

equivalents: calm at the end of the road
another view when the path ends

examples.zh: 事业遇到瓶颈，他告诉自己“行到水穷处，坐看云起时”。
examples.en: Hitting a ceiling at work, he told himself '§'.

examples.zh: 退休后他学会了“行到水穷处，坐看云起时”的心态。
examples.en: After retiring he learned the attitude of '§'.

story.en: Wang Wei wrote it when he lived semi-retired at his villa on Mount Zhongnan, wandering with no set goal.
story.zh: 王维晚年隐居终南山别墅，随兴而游，写超然心境。

usage.en: A quoted line of verse; literary, common in essays, captions and speeches.
usage.zh: 引用的诗句，书面语，常见于作文、文案和演讲。

text: 空山新雨后，天气晚来秋
pinyin: kōng shān xīn yǔ hòu, tiān qì wǎn lái qiū
literal: empty · mountain · new · rain · after, weather · evening · come · autumn
natural: In the empty mountain after fresh rain, the evening air brings autumn

meaning.en: The crisp freshness of mountains after rain at dusk; quoted for tranquil autumn scenery.
meaning.zh: 新雨之后空山清新，傍晚有了秋意，写山居的清幽。

examples.zh: 雨后的公园，正是“空山新雨后，天气晚来秋”的感觉。
examples.en: The park after rain had the feel of '§'.

examples.zh: 民宿门口挂着一副“空山新雨后，天气晚来秋”的对联。
examples.en: A couplet with '§' hung at the guesthouse door.

story.en: Wang Wei describes an autumn evening at his mountain retreat after rain.
story.zh: 王维写山居秋日傍晚雨后的景色。

usage.en: A quoted line of verse; literary, common in essays, captions and speeches.
usage.zh: 引用的诗句，书面语，常见于作文、文案和演讲。

text: 红豆生南国，春来发几枝
pinyin: hóng dòu shēng nán guó, chūn lái fā jǐ zhī
literal: red · bean · grow · south · country, spring · come · sprout · how many · branches
natural: Red beans grow in the southern land; how many branches will they put out this spring?

meaning.en: Red beans symbolise longing; quoted for missing a loved one or friend.
meaning.zh: 红豆生长在南方，春天来了发了几枝？以红豆寄相思。

examples.zh: 情人节，他送了一袋红豆，附上“红豆生南国，春来发几枝”。
examples.en: On Valentine's Day he sent red beans with '§'.

examples.zh: 异乡人看到红豆，会想起“红豆生南国，春来发几枝”。
examples.en: Seeing red beans, those far from home think of '§'.

story.en: A poem sent to a friend, using the red bean (love-pea), a symbol of yearning in classical poetry.
story.zh: 此诗以红豆寄托对友人的思念。

usage.en: Used for love or friendship; some editions read 秋来 for 春来.
usage.zh: 用于相思与友情，有的版本作“秋来发几枝”。

text: 八月湖水平，涵虚混太清
pinyin: bā yuè hú shuǐ píng, hán xū hùn tài qīng
literal: eighth · month · lake · water · level, contain · void · merge · great · clearness
natural: In August the lake is brimming, its depths holding the sky and mingling with it

meaning.en: A vast, brimming lake that mirrors the sky; quoted for expansive scenery.
meaning.zh: 八月湖水涨满，与天空相接，水天一色，写洞庭湖的浩渺。

equivalents: a lake merging with the sky

examples.zh: 站在湖边，只觉“八月湖水平，涵虚混太清”。
examples.en: Standing by the lake I felt only '§'.

examples.zh: 游记里引了“八月湖水平，涵虚混太清”描写洞庭湖。
examples.en: The travelogue quotes '§' to describe Dongting Lake.

origin.source: 孟浩然《望洞庭湖赠张丞相》

story.en: Meng Haoran presented the poem to the chancellor Zhang Jiuling, hinting at his wish for office after describing Lake Dongting.
story.zh: 孟浩然以此诗赠张九龄，借写洞庭湖，委婉表达求仕之意。

usage.en: A quoted line of verse; literary, common in essays, captions and speeches.
usage.zh: 引用的诗句，书面语，常见于作文、文案和演讲。

text: 秦时明月汉时关，万里长征人未还
pinyin: qín shí míng yuè hàn shí guān, wàn lǐ cháng zhēng rén wèi huán
literal: Qin · era · bright · moon · Han · era · pass, ten thousand · li · long · campaign · men · not yet · return
natural: The moon of Qin and the pass of Han remain; the men on the ten-thousand-li campaign have not returned

meaning.en: Frontier wars have gone on for ages and soldiers die far from home; quoted to lament endless war.
meaning.zh: 明月与边关从秦汉至今依旧，远征万里的将士却未能归来，感叹战争的绵延和士兵的牺牲。

equivalents: the same moon, the same pass, but the soldiers never return

examples.zh: 纪念碑前，他想起“秦时明月汉时关，万里长征人未还”。
examples.en: Before the memorial he thought of '§'.

examples.zh: 这部边塞题材的电影以“秦时明月汉时关，万里长征人未还”作开场。
examples.en: The frontier film opened with '§'.

story.en: Wang Changling's frontier ballad, on the long-standing wars between the Chinese and northern tribes.
story.zh: 王昌龄边塞诗名篇，写历代边防战事。

usage.en: A quoted line of verse; literary, common in essays, captions and speeches.
usage.zh: 引用的诗句，书面语，常见于作文、文案和演讲。

text: 黄沙百战穿金甲，不破楼兰终不还
pinyin: huáng shā bǎi zhàn chuān jīn jiǎ, bù pò lóu lán zhōng bù huán
literal: yellow · sand · hundred · battles · wear through · golden · armour, not · break · Loulan · in the end · not · return
natural: In the yellow sands a hundred battles wear out our golden armour; until Loulan is crushed we will not go home

meaning.en: Unflinching determination to see a task through however long it takes.
meaning.zh: 在黄沙中身经百战，铠甲磨破，不打败敌人决不回家，表达坚定的决心。

equivalents: we will not return until we win

examples.zh: 球队喊出“黄沙百战穿金甲，不破楼兰终不还”的口号。
examples.en: The team shouted the slogan '§'.

examples.zh: 他抱着“黄沙百战穿金甲，不破楼兰终不还”的决心投入科研。
examples.en: He plunged into research with the resolve of '§'.

story.en: The seventh of Wang Changling's 'Army Songs': soldiers vow to defeat the western enemy at Loulan, a frontier state.
story.zh: 王昌龄《从军行七首》其四，写戍边将士誓破强敌的壮志。

date.en: Tang dynasty, first half of 8th c.

usage.en: A quoted line of verse; literary, common in essays, captions and speeches.
usage.zh: 引用的诗句，书面语，常见于作文、文案和演讲。

text: 洛阳亲友如相问，一片冰心在玉壶
pinyin: luò yáng qīn yǒu rú xiāng wèn, yī piàn bīng xīn zài yù hú
literal: Luoyang · kin · friends · if · ask after, one · piece · ice · heart · in · jade · pot
natural: If friends in Luoyang ask about me, tell them: a heart of ice in a jade flask

meaning.en: A pure, honest heart that stays untainted; quoted to affirm one's integrity.
meaning.zh: 洛阳的亲友若问起我，就说我的心像玉壶中的冰一样纯洁，表达清白高洁。

equivalents: a heart pure as ice in a jade flask

examples.zh: 面对质疑，他坦然说“洛阳亲友如相问，一片冰心在玉壶”。
examples.en: Faced with doubts he calmly said '§'.

examples.zh: “洛阳亲友如相问，一片冰心在玉壶”，他一生清廉。
examples.en: '§': he was incorruptible all his life.

story.en: Wang Changling, demoted to Jiangning, sees off friend Xin Jian and asks him to tell friends in Luoyang that he remains pure.
story.zh: 王昌龄被贬江宁，送辛渐北归，托其向洛阳亲友表明心迹。

usage.en: A quoted line of verse; literary, common in essays, captions and speeches.
usage.zh: 引用的诗句，书面语，常见于作文、文案和演讲。

text: 莫愁前路无知己，天下谁人不识君
pinyin: mò chóu qián lù wú zhī jǐ, tiān xià shuí rén bù shí jūn
literal: do not · worry · road · ahead · no · bosom friend, under · heaven · who · not · know · you
natural: Do not worry that there are no friends ahead; who under heaven does not know you?

meaning.en: A farewell encouragement: you are so well known that you will find friends everywhere.
meaning.zh: 不要担心前路没有知己，天下谁不认识你，是送别时的鼓励。

equivalents: you'll find friends wherever you go
don't fear for lack of friends ahead

examples.zh: 送同学出国时，我写下“莫愁前路无知己，天下谁人不识君”。
examples.en: When my classmate went abroad I wrote '§'.

examples.zh: “莫愁前路无知己，天下谁人不识君”，你的实力大家都看得到。
examples.en: '§': everyone can see what you can do.

story.en: Gao Shi bids farewell to the lute player Dong Tinglan on a bleak winter day, offering encouragement.
story.zh: 高适送别琴师董庭兰，冬日里以豪语相慰。

usage.zh: 引用的诗句，书面语，常见于作文、文案和演讲。

text: 忽如一夜春风来，千树万树梨花开
pinyin: hū rú yī yè chūn fēng lái, qiān shù wàn shù lí huā kāi
literal: suddenly · as if · one · night · spring · wind · come, thousand · trees · ten thousand · trees · pear · blossoms · open
natural: As if a spring wind had come overnight, a thousand trees, ten thousand trees burst into pear blossoms

meaning.en: Snow-laden trees look like spring blossoms; also used for a sudden, widespread change.
meaning.zh: 一夜大雪，树上积雪如梨花盛开，也比喻事物突然大量涌现。

examples.zh: 一夜大雪后，窗外正是“忽如一夜春风来，千树万树梨花开”。
examples.en: After the overnight snow, the view outside was '§'.

examples.zh: 短视频平台上，新玩法“忽如一夜春风来，千树万树梨花开”般涌现。
examples.en: On short-video platforms the new trend appeared like '§'.

origin.source: 岑参《白雪歌送武判官归京》

story.en: Cen Shen on a snowy day at the northwestern frontier, seeing off Judge Wu back to the capital.
story.zh: 岑参在西北边塞送武判官回京，写雪景。

usage.en: A quoted line of verse; literary, common in essays, captions and speeches.

text: 马上相逢无纸笔，凭君传语报平安
pinyin: mǎ shàng xiāng féng wú zhǐ bǐ, píng jūn chuán yǔ bào píng ān
literal: horse · on · meet · no · paper · brush, rely on · you · pass · word · report · safe
natural: Meeting on horseback with no paper or brush, I rely on you to tell them I am safe

meaning.en: Asking a passer-by to take word home; quoted for brief news to family.
meaning.zh: 在马上相遇没有纸笔，请您带个口信回家报平安。

equivalents: a message home by word of mouth

examples.zh: 在机场遇到老乡，他说“马上相逢无纸笔，凭君传语报平安”。
examples.en: He met a fellow villager at the airport and said '§'.

examples.zh: 出差途中她给家里发了“马上相逢无纸笔，凭君传语报平安”式的短信。
examples.en: On her trip she sent home a '§'-style short message.

story.en: Cen Shen, on his way west to a post, meets an envoy heading to the capital and asks him to carry word to his family.
story.zh: 岑参西行赴任途中，遇入京使者，托其带口信回家。

usage.en: A quoted line of verse; literary, common in essays, captions and speeches.
usage.zh: 引用的诗句，书面语，常见于作文、文案和演讲。

text: 葡萄美酒夜光杯，欲饮琵琶马上催
pinyin: pú táo měi jiǔ yè guāng bēi, yù yǐn pí pá mǎ shàng cuī
literal: grape · fine · wine · night-glowing · cup, about to · drink · pipa · horseback · urge
natural: Fine grape wine in glowing jade cups; as we are about to drink, the pipa urges us on from horseback

meaning.en: A lavish frontier feast with music, tinged with soldiers' bitterness; quoted for a festive drinking scene.
meaning.zh: 葡萄美酒盛在夜光杯里，正要饮时马上琵琶声催促，描绘边塞将士宴饮。

equivalents: wine in glowing cups and music

examples.zh: 酒庄的广告语是“葡萄美酒夜光杯，欲饮琵琶马上催”。
examples.en: The winery's slogan is '§'.

examples.zh: 聚会上他吟道：“葡萄美酒夜光杯，欲饮琵琶马上催”。
examples.en: At the party he chanted: '§'.

story.en: Wang Han's 'Liangzhou Song', describing soldiers feasting at the frontier and drinking despite the danger of war.
story.zh: 王翰《凉州词》，写边塞将士宴饮的情景。

text: 黄河远上白云间，一片孤城万仞山
pinyin: huáng hé yuǎn shàng bái yún jiān, yī piàn gū chéng wàn rèn shān
literal: Yellow · River · far · rise · white · clouds · among, one · patch · lone · city · ten thousand · fathoms · mountains
natural: The Yellow River rises far into the white clouds; a lone city sits among mountains ten thousand fathoms high

meaning.en: A bleak, vast frontier landscape; quoted for desolate scenery in the northwest.
meaning.zh: 黄河远远伸向白云，一座孤城依傍高山，写西北边塞的苍茫荒凉。

equivalents: a lone city among towering mountains

examples.zh: 站在玉门关遗址，眼前是“黄河远上白云间，一片孤城万仞山”的景象。
examples.en: At the Yumen Pass ruins the scene before me was '§'.

examples.zh: 纪录片开头的旁白是“黄河远上白云间，一片孤城万仞山”。
examples.en: The documentary's opening narration was '§'.

story.en: Wang Zhihuan's frontier ballad, set at Yumen Pass, which also has the famous line about the spring wind not passing the pass.

text: 月落乌啼霜满天，江枫渔火对愁眠
pinyin: yuè luò wū tí shuāng mǎn tiān, jiāng fēng yú huǒ duì chóu mián
literal: moon · set · crow · caw · frost · fill · sky, river · maples · fishing · lights · face · sorrow · sleep
natural: The moon sets, a crow caws, frost fills the sky; river maples and fishing lights face my sleepless sorrow

meaning.en: A traveller's sleepless melancholy on a cold night; quoted for loneliness on a journey.
meaning.zh: 月落乌啼，寒霜满天，江边枫树渔火相伴，旅人愁眠难安。

equivalents: lonely and sad on the road

examples.zh: 深夜出差在外，辗转难眠，想起“月落乌啼霜满天，江枫渔火对愁眠”。
examples.en: On a business trip, tossing awake at night, I thought of '§'.

examples.zh: 游客在寒山寺外念起“月落乌啼霜满天，江枫渔火对愁眠”。
examples.en: Outside Hanshan Temple, tourists recited '§'.

story.en: Zhang Ji, travelling after failing the exams (traditionally), moored at Fengqiao near Suzhou and heard the Hanshan Temple bell at midnight.
story.zh: 张继夜泊苏州枫桥，闻寒山寺夜半钟声而作。

usage.en: A quoted line of verse; literary, common in essays, captions and speeches.
usage.zh: 引用的诗句，书面语，常见于作文、文案和演讲。

text: 少小离家老大回，乡音无改鬓毛衰
pinyin: shào xiǎo lí jiā lǎo dà huí, xiāng yīn wú gǎi bìn máo cuī
literal: young · small · leave · home · old · grown · return, local · accent · no · change · temple · hair · thinning
natural: I left home young and returned old; my accent is unchanged but my hair has thinned

meaning.en: Returning home after decades: the accent stays, appearance has changed; quoted for homecoming and passing time.
meaning.zh: 年少离家，年老才回，口音未变，鬓发已稀，感叹时光流逝。

equivalents: the accent stays while the hair thins

examples.zh: 七十岁的他回到故乡，感叹“少小离家老大回，乡音无改鬓毛衰”。
examples.en: Returning home at seventy, he sighed '§'.

examples.zh: 海外游子归来，常有“少小离家老大回，乡音无改鬓毛衰”之感。
examples.en: Those returning from abroad often feel '§'.

story.en: Poet He Zhizhang retired from court at over eighty and returned to Yue (Zhejiang) after about fifty years.
story.zh: 贺知章八十多岁辞官返回越州故乡，离家近五十年。

usage.en: A quoted line of verse; literary, common in essays, captions and speeches.
usage.zh: 引用的诗句，书面语，常见于作文、文案和演讲。

text: 不知细叶谁裁出，二月春风似剪刀
pinyin: bù zhī xì yè shuí cái chū, èr yuè chūn fēng sì jiǎn dāo
literal: not · know · fine · leaves · who · cut · out, second · month · spring · wind · like · scissors
natural: Who cut out the delicate leaves? The spring wind of February is like scissors

meaning.en: Praising the creative power of spring; quoted for willow-green scenes and imaginative metaphor.
meaning.zh: 不知是谁裁出细叶，原来二月春风像剪刀，赞美春天的创造力。

examples.zh: 春天来了，柳树发芽，正是“不知细叶谁裁出，二月春风似剪刀”。
examples.en: Spring has come and willows bud: just '§'.

examples.zh: 老师以“不知细叶谁裁出，二月春风似剪刀”讲解比喻手法。
examples.en: The teacher used '§' to explain metaphor.

story.en: He Zhizhang's 'Ode to the Willow' ends with the image of spring wind as scissors cutting the willow's leaves.
story.zh: 贺知章《咏柳》末二句，把春风比作剪刀。

usage.en: A quoted line of verse; literary, common in essays, captions and speeches.
usage.zh: 引用的诗句，书面语，常见于作文、文案和演讲。

text: 前不见古人，后不见来者
pinyin: qián bù jiàn gǔ rén, hòu bù jiàn lái zhě
literal: front · not · see · ancients, behind · not · see · those who come
natural: Before me I see no men of old; behind me I see none yet to come

meaning.en: A lone figure standing between past and future; quoted for loneliness and singularity.
meaning.zh: 往前看不到古人，往后看不到来者，表达孤独以及时空无尽之感。

examples.zh: 在无人区徒步，他念出“前不见古人，后不见来者”。
examples.en: Hiking in the wilderness he recited '§'.

examples.zh: 这位科学家独自探索，真有“前不见古人，后不见来者”之感。
examples.en: Exploring alone, the scientist truly felt '§'.

story.en: Chen Zi'ang, ignored by the military commander during a northern campaign, climbed the Youzhou terrace and wrote this lament.
story.zh: 陈子昂随军北征，建议不被采纳，登幽州台而作。

usage.en: A quoted line of verse; literary, common in essays, captions and speeches.
usage.zh: 引用的诗句，书面语，常见于作文、文案和演讲。

text: 海上生明月，天涯共此时
pinyin: hǎi shàng shēng míng yuè, tiān yá gòng cǐ shí
literal: sea · above · rise · bright · moon, world's · edge · share · this · moment
natural: A bright moon rises over the sea; at the ends of the earth we share this moment

meaning.en: Even apart, people share the same moon; quoted in Mid-Autumn wishes.
meaning.zh: 明月从海上升起，天涯远隔的人此刻共赏，表达思念与共情。

examples.zh: 中秋节的视频通话里，我们念着“海上生明月，天涯共此时”。
examples.en: In the Mid-Autumn video call we recited '§'.

examples.zh: “海上生明月，天涯共此时”，今晚的月亮也照着你。
examples.en: '§': tonight's moon shines on you too.

story.en: Zhang Jiuling wrote the poem looking at the moon and thinking of a far-off loved one.
story.zh: 张九龄望月怀念远方的亲友。

usage.en: Common in Mid-Autumn wishes and messages.
usage.zh: 中秋祝福中常用。

text: 落霞与孤鹜齐飞，秋水共长天一色
pinyin: luò xiá yǔ gū wù qí fēi, qiū shuǐ gòng cháng tiān yī sè
literal: falling · glow · and · lone · wild duck · together · fly, autumn · water · with · long · sky · one · colour
natural: Sunset clouds fly together with a lone wild duck; the autumn waters share one colour with the sky

meaning.en: A celebrated image of harmony between water and sky; quoted for beautiful scenery and fine parallel prose.
meaning.zh: 晚霞与孤鹜齐飞，秋水与长天一色，描绘水天相接的美景，也是骈文名句。

equivalents: sky and water in one colour
sunset glow with a lone duck

examples.zh: 洞庭湖的黄昏，真是“落霞与孤鹜齐飞，秋水共长天一色”。
examples.en: Dusk on Dongting Lake is truly '§'.

examples.zh: 作文里引用“落霞与孤鹜齐飞，秋水共长天一色”，对仗工整。
examples.en: The essay quotes '§', with neat parallelism.

story.en: Wang Bo, visiting Tengwang Pavilion in Nanchang, wrote the preface at a banquet; this is its best-known couplet.
story.zh: 王勃游洪都，在滕王阁宴会上作序，此为序中名句。

usage.en: A quoted line of verse; literary, common in essays, captions and speeches.
usage.zh: 引用的诗句，书面语，常见于作文、文案和演讲。

text: 老当益壮，宁移白首之心；穷且益坚，不坠青云之志
pinyin: lǎo dāng yì zhuàng, nìng yí bái shǒu zhī xīn, qióng qiě yì jiān, bù zhuì qīng yún zhī zhì
literal: old · should · more · vigorous, how could · change · white · head's · heart; poor · yet · more · firm, not · fall · blue · clouds' · ambition
natural: The old should grow more vigorous; how could grey hair change one's heart? In poverty be firmer still, and never drop one's lofty aims

meaning.en: Keep ambition alive in old age and adversity.
meaning.zh: 年纪越大越要有壮志，处境越穷越要意志坚定，不放弃远大志向。

examples.zh: 他七十岁开始读博，真是“老当益壮，宁移白首之心；穷且益坚，不坠青云之志”。
examples.en: He began his doctorate at seventy: truly '§'.

examples.zh: “老当益壮，宁移白首之心；穷且益坚，不坠青云之志”，困境不能磨灭他的志向。
examples.en: '§': hardship could not wear down his ambition.

story.en: In the preface, Wang Bo cites the examples of Ma Yuan and Feng Tang to express his determination despite setbacks.
story.zh: 王勃在序中引马援、冯唐事，表明虽遭困顿而志不改。

usage.en: Often the two halves are quoted separately; 老当益壮 and 穷且益坚 are also used on their own.
usage.zh: 常分开引用，“老当益壮”“穷且益坚”也单独使用。

text: 鹅鹅鹅，曲项向天歌
pinyin: é é é, qū xiàng xiàng tiān gē
literal: goose · goose · goose, bent · neck · toward · sky · sing
natural: Goose, goose, goose, with curved neck it sings to the sky

meaning.en: The first poem many Chinese children learn; quoted for early learning and children's verse.
meaning.zh: 许多中国孩子最先学的诗，常用来指童年启蒙。

examples.zh: 宝宝刚会说话，就跟着念“鹅鹅鹅，曲项向天歌”。
examples.en: The baby had just begun to talk and was already reciting '§'.

examples.zh: 幼儿园里传来“鹅鹅鹅，曲项向天歌”的朗读声。
examples.en: Recitations of '§' rang out from the kindergarten.

story.en: Said to be composed by Luo Binwang at the age of seven.
story.zh: 相传骆宾王七岁时所作。

usage.en: A children's rhyme; used for early education, nostalgia.
usage.zh: 儿歌式诗句，用于启蒙教育和童年回忆。
